verdict.rationale: Bolna's security docs offer Indian data residency, and its on-premise Docker/Kubernetes self-hosting gives operators control over where data lives. Together these cover the data-residency part of the story. Nothing in the pack mentions HIPAA, a signed BAA, or SOC 2, so the regulated-workload compliance core is unevidenced. Missing for 10: HIPAA/BAA support, SOC 2 attestation, residency regions beyond India, independent corroboration.
